profile.headline: 💻 Staff Software Engineer | Front-End & Full-Stack Development | Performance Optimization Expert 🌐
profile.summary:
With over 10 years of experience in front-end and full-stack development, I specialize in building fast, scalable, and user-friendly web applications that make an impact. Whether it's optimizing performance for e-commerce platforms or delivering intuitive user experiences on large-scale enterprise systems, I bring a blend of technical expertise and product thinking to every project.
My work spans high-growth sectors like retail, media, and enterprise tech—always with a focus on accessibility, performance, and clean, maintainable code. I take pride in shipping features that not only improve user experience but also drive measurable business outcomes, like faster page loads and streamlined checkout flows.
Beyond coding, I’m passionate about collaboration, mentorship, and fostering inclusive engineering cultures. I’ve actively contributed to the WooCommerce open-source project, submitted PRs, and mentored new contributors. At Globant, I launched a volunteer mentorship circle to support junior engineers and improve onboarding. I also spearheaded initiatives like Code Review Guidelines, boosting code quality and team collaboration across distributed teams.
Fluent in English and a native Spanish speaker, I excel in cross-cultural, remote-first environments—bridging communication gaps and building strong global teams.
Let’s connect if you’re looking for a passionate engineer who’s just as committed to people as they are to clean code and great products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Proposed, led, architected, and implemented a scalable Vertical Micro-Frontend platform using modern TypeScript-based full-stack patterns to unify customer-facing applications built on heterogeneous stacks and identity systems, enabling a seamless single-authentication experience and consistent user journey across products while ensuring maintainability, reliability, and performance at scale. Collaborated with multiple cross-functional teams across product, design, identity, and platform engineering to deliver complex distributed system integrations on schedule while mentoring engineers, raising code quality standards, and strengthening engineering practices.

Key  Achievements:
• Accelerated adoption across additional teams by standardizing platform bootstrapping, routing, and authentication integration patterns, significantly reducing onboarding complexity and time-to-market for new features and applications.
• Streamlined developer experience and extensibility by establishing a centralized, reusable TypeScript component architecture and design system as a single source of truth, enabling consistent UI/UX, scalable feature ownership, and shared engineering velocity across all onboarded products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Automattic, I lead front-end architecture and product experience innovation for WooCommerce, designing scalable, accessible, and high-performing solutions that power global eCommerce. My focus is on building intuitive, extensible interfaces that delight users and empower developers, while ensuring seamless integration across teams and tech stacks. From modernizing legacy systems to mentoring engineers and driving community-informed development, I bring a collaborative, product-focused mindset to every challenge.

Key Achievements:
• Accelerated product creation by 26% and increased user satisfaction by 45% through a redesigned, accessible interface built for flexibility and scale.
• Streamlined developer experience by introducing a modular, template-based system and incorporating community feedback for agile iteration.
• Boosted adoption and flexibility by migrating the "add to cart" form to Gutenberg blocks, using a hybrid integration model to preserve compatibility.
• Enhanced scalability and performance in product variation management with asynchronous processes, WebSocket-powered feedback, and efficient pagination.
• Championed accessibility and inclusive design, applying WCAG standards and partnering with designers to embed these principles across key features.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · React · Redux · PHP · MySQL · Jest

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Globant, I led development efforts across global digital platforms—shaping e-commerce, media, and streaming experiences for millions of users worldwide. My focus was on delivering intuitive, high-performance solutions that simplified user journeys and drove business outcomes. Whether optimizing booking flows or redesigning checkout systems, I brought a balance of technical depth and user empathy to everything I built.

Key Achievements:
• Led enhancements for high-visibility digital platforms, including e-commerce storefronts and streaming systems, elevating user experience across global markets.
• Streamlined core workflows like checkout and booking, significantly reducing user friction, improving operational efficiency, and boosting both revenue and conversion rates.
• Delivered full-stack solutions through close collaboration with design, product, and QA teams, maintaining a sharp focus on performance, accessibility, and scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · Problem Solving · Troubleshooting · Leadership · Adaptability

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a contract Senior Software Engineer at Total Wine & More, I focused on optimizing the checkout experience to drive conversions and streamline performance. My work delivered tangible improvements to user experience, speed, and revenue—all within a fast-paced retail environment where every millisecond mattered.

Key Achievements:
• Increased monthly revenue by 1.3% by redesigning the checkout flow into a more efficient, user-friendly experience with fewer steps.
• Cut purchase process time by 5 minutes, improving rendering speed and reducing cart abandonment through smoother interactions.
• Optimized backend performance by reprioritizing critical tasks, enhancing responsiveness and directly supporting revenue growth.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · HTML5 · CSS · Java · Go (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Redis · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React · Micro Frontend · Jest · Spring Framework · PubSub · Docker · Grafana

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
During my contract with The Walt Disney Company, I focused on optimizing internal systems and user-facing tools to improve operational efficiency and user satisfaction. By reengineering content management workflows and refining server-side processes, I helped elevate platform performance and user experience at scale—ensuring smoother content operations for one of the world’s most iconic brands.

Key Achievements:
• Increased user satisfaction by 61% and cut content management task time by 12% through a usability-focused redesign of internal processes.
• Reduced server resource consumption by 33%, improving response times and platform stability by optimizing resource-heavy operations.
• Enhanced client-side rendering speed by reprioritizing server task processing, resulting in a more responsive and seamless user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · HTML5 · CSS · Node · Java · PostgreSQL · Redis · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · React · Tailwind CSS · Next.js · Spring Framework · Docker · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a contract Senior Software Engineer with LATAM Airlines, I played a pivotal role in modernizing the flight booking experience for millions of users across the Americas. I led key improvements to performance, reliability, and transactional flows—enhancing trust, boosting conversions, and directly impacting business outcomes in a high-traffic, high-stakes environment. My work helped transform the airline’s digital infrastructure into a faster, more resilient platform built for scale and user satisfaction.

Key Achievements:
• Reduced flight search load time from over 15 seconds to under 1 second, leading to an 8% increase in conversion rates.
• Raised booking success rate to 93% by ensuring real-time flight availability consistency throughout the purchase journey.
• Cut payment error rate to 11% and drove a 34% boost in conversions by enhancing transaction speed and reliability.
• Increased upsell revenue by building a paid flight reservation feature that improved flexibility and customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · HTML5 · CSS · React · Next.js · Node · Java · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Docker · Kubernetes · Compliance PCI · Spring Boot · Grafana · Splunk · Dynatrace · Redis · Sabre

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Cybercenter S.A., I developed modular, scalable frameworks to support rapid website deployment across varied client needs—most notably for the Autopase.cl portal. I collaborated closely with product and design teams to turn business vision into clean, high-performance code. Focused on speed, accessibility, and flexibility, I ensured the platforms we built were not only fast and reliable, but inclusive by design.

Key Achievements:
• Built modular frameworks with interchangeable themes and backend modules for rapid, client-specific deployments.
• Boosted performance and scalability through critical-path optimization, efficient data-fetching, and advanced code-splitting techniques.
• Improved accessibility and inclusivity by leading WCAG-compliant UX design initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · CSS · PHP · PostgreSQL · Laravel

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Databyte S.A., I led the design and development of diverse software solutions spanning web, mobile, and embedded systems. From building a web interface to configure DD-WRT routers, to launching a hybrid mobile social sports app, I thrived in fast-paced environments where innovation met practicality. I also created a dynamic website generation and deployment platform, streamlining client onboarding and delivery timelines. My work combined technical range with a passion for intuitive UX and scalable systems.

Key Achievements:
• Developed a hybrid mobile app and web-based router configuration tool, improving user experience and accessibility across platforms.
• Built a runtime website generation platform, significantly enhancing deployment efficiency and scalability for web solutions.
• Designed and launched Databyte’s corporate site with dynamic functionality and an engaging, user-centric experience.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · CSS · PHP · MySQL · PostgreSQL · Laravel · Apache Cordova · AngularJS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a self-employed founder and lead architect, I designed and delivered a full-scale web-based ERP system for a mid-sized enterprise—an end-to-end platform integrating inventory, sales, finance, payroll, and HR operations. I owned everything from architectural decisions to hands-on coding, module design, and security compliance. This experience sharpened my ability to think like both a product owner and engineer, building scalable systems that met real business needs and drove operational efficiency.

Key Achievements:
• Developed and integrated multiple ERP modules, enabling seamless operations across departments and significantly boosting organizational efficiency.
• Increased productivity through streamlined workflows and scalable architecture tailored to enterprise use.
• Engineered robust security protocols, including role-based access controls and user authentication, ensuring safe and reliable system usage.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · CSS · PostgreSQL · C# · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a freelance Software Engineer, I delivered full-cycle development solutions for a diverse client base—ranging from dynamic websites to enterprise-level desktop applications. I specialized in translating complex requirements into scalable, user-friendly systems, leveraging a wide stack of technologies including JavaScript, C#, PHP, and multiple databases. My freelance years were rooted in versatility and ownership, where I sharpened my ability to architect secure, performant, and accessible applications that drove measurable impact for clients across industries.

Key Achievements:
• Designed and deployed a unified ERP system, centralizing core business functions and significantly improving operational productivity.
• Reduced page-load times by 90% on high-traffic apps through advanced caching and lazy-loading techniques.
• Enhanced security and compliance by implementing robust, role-based access controls and secure authentication systems.
• Instrumented real-time analytics and feedback loops, improving issue resolution and informing iterative enhancements.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · CSS · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · MySQL · PostgreSQL · Java · Spring Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At the University of Information Sciences, I combined software engineering with academic mentorship—building secure, data-driven applications while teaching and guiding the next generation of developers. I led the development of a complex web-based system for prison facility operations, where data sensitivity and business logic precision were paramount. In parallel, I taught undergraduate courses in Mathematics and Computer Programming, blending theory with real-world application and empowering students to build with purpose.

Key Achievements:
• Engineered a robust, secure application for prison operations, integrating complex rules and sensitive data management.
• Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) to reduce breach risks and ensure secure, permissioned access aligned with organizational roles.
• Delivered hands-on instruction in software development and mathematics, mentoring students in foundational and applied computing skills.
• Translated complex technical requirements into functional, scalable code using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Groovy Grails, and Postgres.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · CSS · PostgreSQL · Groovy & Grails · Java · Hibernate · Spring Framework
